text:
Maya K: quick sync: propose adding `intent`, `expiry_window`, and `rollback_policy` fields to pin/rollout metadata. goal: make serving behavior explicit so runtime + ops can agree on semantics.

Jon S: sounds useful. can you list exact allowed values and what each implies for runtime eviction?

Maya K: draft values: `intent` = \"permanent|session|transient\". semantics: permanent never auto-evicts (unless manual), session ties to client's session lifecycle, transient uses `expiry_window` (seconds) after which it becomes eligible for eviction. `expiry_window` optional, `rollback_policy` optional enum: \"previous_variant|regional_fallback|auto-retrain\".

Ravi D: conflict handling? multiple actors might set pins concurrently (infra autoscaler, deploy tool, manual). we need deterministic resolution.

Maya K: propose resolution order: 1) explicit override marker from actor with RBAC wins, 2) same-owner last-write wins, 3) if different owners and no override, prefer higher-intent (permanent > session > transient), tie-break by last modified timestamp. record `conflict_resolution` entry in audit log.

Eve T: ops wants a forced-evict API for emergencies. add `force_evict` endpoint that requires an admin token + audit entry. also we should expose `pin_state` enum for runtime: \"active|stale|evicted|overridden\" so dashboards can surface it.

Jon S: storage/indexing: we need queries to find soon-to-expire transient pins for preemptive cleanup. add a TTL index on `effective_expiry` and composite `(tenant, model, effective_expiry)` for scans. runtime should keep an in-memory priority queue for top-N soonest expiries to avoid full table scan.

ops-bot: estimate: adding three small fields avg +48 bytes/pin. active pins ~450k across fleet. background migration write ops ~5.4M writes. recommend rolling backfill over 3 days to smooth I/O.

Ravi D: telemetry: emit `pin.create`, `pin.override`, `pin.evict`, `pin.expire`, `pin.conflict_resolved` with labels owner, intent, outcome. add SLO: <1% unexpected evictions per week. alerts for >3x baseline `pin.conflict_resolved`.

Maya K: API example (patch):
```
PATCH /api/v1/models/{model_id}/pins/{pin_id}
{
  \"intent\": \"transient\",
  \"expiry_window\": 7200,
  \"rollback_policy\": \"previous_variant\",
  \"pin_note\": \"short note: canary pin for payment-flow-v2\",
  \"actor\": \"deploy-service/team-canary\"
}
```

Jon S: runtime behavior: when transient expires, mark `pin_state=stale` and keep serving until LRU eviction or hard eviction window (configurable per-tenant). emit trace span `pin.expiry.mark` and attach pin metadata to traces for any requests hitting stale pins.

Eve T: security: ensure `actor` is just an opaque service id, not a key. RBAC enforcement at control plane for overrides. log actor and auth method in audit logs.

Ravi D: migration plan: 1) schema add nullable fields, 2) deploy server 1 to accept and ignore new fields, 3) client rollout, 4) backfill non-null where possible, 5) enable conflict policy + force-evict endpoint behind feature flag, 6) monitor metrics for 2 weeks.

logger-bot: created ticket ARCH-9831 with checklist (schema, index, runtime, telemetry, force-evict, runbook).

Maya K: assign owners: Jon runtime/indexes, Ravi telemetry+alerts, Eve ops/runbook+RBAC, I'll do schema + migration. will open PRs and link.

Jon S: small extra: include sample log line for parsing:
`pin_event ts=2026-03-21T15:04:05Z event=evict pin_id=pl-9b7 tenant=acme model=ctr-7 intent=transient expiry_ts=2026-03-21T17:04:05Z actor=deploy-service outcome=evicted reason=soft_expiry`

Eve T: good. I'll add parser and dashboard panels after PRs land.

Maya K: thanks all. we'll iterate on exact enum names in the schema PR. end.
